study: E1c seed-diverse replication of E1b (LoRA merge-overlap paper)
written_kst: 2026-09-26, before any E1c training (see prereg_e1c.sha256 file time)

written_after_results_known.E1b: H1 FAIL rho=-0.194 CI[-0.521,0.203]; H2 INCONCLUSIVE rho=-0.044 CI[-0.425,0.316]; O_A null z 16-95; min theta_min 45.1 deg; gate never fired
written_after_results_known.E3: no method met 'beats TA'; PICO_TA +0.22pp (Holm p 0.033, <0.5pp); FORCEGATE -0.03pp; GATE == TA
written_after_results_known.reason: all E1b adapters shared seed 0 (identical LoRA-A init, data order); E1c removes shared init from every primary pair

recipe: E1b prereg.json recipe verbatim except seed

applies_to: transformers.set_seed before model construction (LoRA-A kaiming init, classifier head init)

budgets.source: E1b prereg.json budgets; mnli from deviations_d1.json (full pool, 36723 steps)

integrity.rule: E1b section 2 verbatim (a) majority+10pp / stsb spearman>=0.70, (b) GLUE ref-5pp, (c) logit equivalence 1e-4, structural
integrity.exclusion: a task whose seed-1 adapter fails is removed with all its pairs from every E1c population (P, S1, S2)
integrity.seed0_recheck: e1b stage0 re-run on seed-0 adapters; singles must match E1b stage0.json within 1e-6; E1b values are used as references

P_primary.def: mixed-seed cross-task pairs: for each unordered {i,j} of valid tasks, alphabetically-first task (python sorted) uses seed-0 adapter (t1), other task uses seed-1 adapter (t2)

S1_secondary.def: seed-1-only cross-task pairs, E1b task-list order

S2_secondary.def: same-task seed pairs t@s0 (t1) x t@s1 (t2)

predictors.def: E1b section 3 verbatim (O_A, tv_cosine, O_B, mean/min theta_min, n layers theta_min<30, sign conflict top20, norm ratio, null z (1000, seed 0))
predictors.equivalence_gate: e1c stage1 on R0 reproduces E1b predictors.csv, max rel diff <= 1e-9

merge.selection: per pair, max mean normalized held-out score (1000 held-out TRAIN per task), ties -> smaller lambda
merge.D: 1 - mean of the two normalized eval-set scores at lambda*
merge.equivalence_gate: e1c stage2 on R0 pairs cola-sst2 and rte-wic reproduces E1b pair_results.csv within 1e-9

analysis_primary.permutation: 10000 task relabelings of the D matrix, predictor fixed, np.random.default_rng(0); one-sided p=(1+#{rho_perm>=rho_obs})/10001
analysis_primary.bootstrap: task-block 2000 reps, default_rng(0), pairs of distinct resampled indices, skip <4 distinct pairs, percentile 95% CI
analysis_primary.task_identity: task name of each side (seed ignored); index order = E1b task list restricted to valid tasks
analysis_primary.PASS: rho >= 0.4 AND Holm p < 0.05 AND >= 75% LOTO rho > 0.2

analysis_secondary.S1: same statistics and rule applied descriptively
analysis_secondary.D_reliability: Spearman of per-task-pair D (and O_A, tv_cosine) between R0, S1, P

per_pair: E1b gate@lam*TA and own-lam vs TA

e3_subset.code: e3.py run() + merges.py unmodified, amendment-A2 grids and selection
e3_subset.stats: mean, bootstrap over 14 tasks 2000 reps default_rng(0), two-sided sign-flip 10000 default_rng(0), W/T/L; gate vs TA on pairs with >=1 FAIL layer (mean + sign-flip if n>=5)

analysis_secondary.OA_shared_vs_mixed: O_A, null z, tv_cosine, min theta_min distributions in R0, S1, P (+S2); paired P-R0 and P-S1 Wilcoxon; fraction of P above null p95
analysis_secondary.other: fixed-lambda rho, secondary predictors, TIES-lite/gate method comparison for P and S1

compute_budget.definition: first E1c training launch to end of last E1c GPU job
